title: Children at Backyard Party with Gifts, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An endearing outdoor snapshot capturing six infants and toddlers gathered together for a celebratory party, likely a young child's birthday. The children are dressed in 1930s playwear and ruffled dresses, seated on miniature wooden chairs and a small wicker armchair. In front of them sits a small table draped in white cloth holding wrapped gifts. The setting features a residential backyard with lush garden shrubs, clapboard house siding, and a wooden clothesline post. The print is framed with a decorative geometric corner border and deckled edges.
